description: Update quantities for one or more existing inventory rows. Accepts a batch. Use remove_inventory to delete a row entirely. Requires IWMM_API_KEY.

cardId.description: Internal IWMM card UUID. Get from search_cards or get_card.

isFoil.description: Whether this is the foil variant. Foil and non-foil are tracked as separate rows.

quantity.description: Total quantity for this card+finish. 0 removes the row.

name: update_inventory
